## Publish gate: landing hero

**Going out:** Landing page hero copy, UK audience. No schedule given.

**Checks**
- **Claims:**
  - "Packed by hand in Bristol" is on the policy list ("every tin is packed by hand in Bristol").
  - "Certified organic by the Soil Association" is on the policy list.
  - **"Free UK delivery on all orders" fails.** The policy only backs free UK delivery on orders over £25. As written, it promises free delivery on a £5 order, which is a false offer claim and a likely complaint.
- **Regulated claims (prices and offers):** The delivery line is the only issue. Fixing the threshold resolves it.
- **House style:** The packed-by-hand-in-Bristol point appears twice in three sentences, which reads as padding. I merged it into one line.
- **Disclosure:** Nothing to label. There is no ad, partnership, affiliate link or AI-generated content in this copy.

**Fixed (suggested rewrite)**
> Loose leaf tea, every tin packed by hand in Bristol. Certified organic by the Soil Association. Free UK delivery on orders over £25.

- Restored the £25 threshold on delivery.
- Removed the duplicated "packed by hand in Bristol".

**Needs a decision**
- Confirm the £25 threshold is still current. If the business wants free delivery on all orders, that needs to be added to the policy first, with a review date.

**Approver:** The policy doesn't name one, so I need an explicit yes from you (or whoever owns the landing page) on the rewritten copy above. The original draft should not go out as written. I haven't recorded any approval.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "Free UK delivery on all orders.", "type": "other"}], "publish": false}
```
